definitions.gloss: to punch, to strike, to hit
definitions.explanation: To hit someone with the fist or hand.

examples.english: To punch someone in the face.

examples.japanese: {喧嘩|けんか}になって{相手|あいて}を{殴|なぐ}ってしまった。
examples.english: It turned into a fight and I ended up punching the other person.

notes:
{殴|なぐ}る is a transitive verb meaning to punch or strike with the fist.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: [person]を{殴|なぐ}る or [body part]を{殴|なぐ}る

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {顔|かお}を{殴|なぐ}る: to punch in the face
- {頭|あたま}を{殴|なぐ}る: to hit on the head
- {殴|なぐ}られる: to be punched (passive)
- {殴|なぐ}り{合|あ}う: to fight, exchange blows

RELATED 'HITTING' VERBS:
- {殴|なぐ}る: to punch (fist, strong)
- {叩|たた}く: to hit, slap (open hand, lighter)
- {打|う}つ: to hit, strike (general, also for typing)
- {蹴|け}る: to kick
- {殴|なぐ}りつける: to strike hard, punch violently

LEGAL/FORMAL TERMS:
- {暴行|ぼうこう}: assault
- {暴力|ぼうりょく}: violence
- {傷害|しょうがい}: bodily injury
